summary: Tested First Goal (team + match pages, API) and the yellow-card forecasts (cards model) on match pages, the Finder (Likelihood/Form/Run, Players/Teams), Track Record and Insights, plus regressions (Events tab, League Referees, Squad grid hide) and mobile at 390px. New pytest file test_first_goal_cards.py (15 tests) plus the regression test_phase5_extras.py (28 tests): 43/43 pass after fixing two bugs in my own test file. Checked all 430 final matches in the DB: first_goal_side matches the first goal event every time (own goals included). Every UI flow works and there were no page errors. Only minor UX issues were found.

minor.issue: match_yellow_cards is the same on both team rows of a match, so Form/Run results list each team separately ('Lazio · 5 or more in 4 of 8 games'). The card shows a team name for what is a whole-match stat, and the two teams of one fixture can both appear for the same match totals.

Match yellow forecasts are stored with team_iid = home. On the match page, the Team filter set to the away team (fc-side = Bologna) hides both match-yellow cards. The 'Both teams' card also shows only the home crest.

design_issues.screen: ForecastCard 'Why' panel (football.css .fcard-why dd has text-transform: capitalize)
issues: The referee reason shows in Title Case: 'No Referee Named Yet, So The League Average Is Used.' Only apply capitalize to short value dds such as rotation, not to the reason sentence (dd.fcard-reason).
Percentages are rounded separately, so they can add up to 101% (Lecce: Scored first 38% + Conceded first 63%). Cosmetic.

Picking 'Yellow cards' keeps the default line '2 or more'. There are no 2+ yellow forecasts, so that search returns nothing. Suggest snapping the line to 1 for yellow_cards (and to 4 for match_yellow_cards).
Says '1 games in a row with 1 or more'. Should be '1 game' (probably an older issue).
The stat filter only offers Shots/SOT/Tackles/Corners, with no Yellow cards option. Fine if this is by design.

action_items: Optional: stop capitalising the long reason text in .fcard-why dd (text-transform: capitalize makes the referee sentence Title Case)
Optional: snap the Finder line to 1 for yellow_cards and to 4 for match_yellow_cards when the stat is picked in Likelihood mode
Optional: show match yellow cards under both teams' side filter on the match page; show the fixture (not one team) and remove duplicates in Form/Run team results for match_yellow_cards
Optional: fix the '1 games in a row' plural
critical_code_review_comments: queries.team_first_goal: games[].minute comes from the first goal event in match_events. If match_events is missing for a match where first_goal_side is set, minute is None (fine). Logic verified against all 430 finals.

cards_model.run_match: player yellow forecasts depend on existing engine player forecasts for p_play. If the engine has not run for a match, there are no player card forecasts (by design, but worth noting).
cards_model.league_numbers scans every player_match_stats row for the league on each run_league call. Fine at the current size.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the flows tested (minor UX notes only)

seed_data_creation: Recreated test_e1_user/test_e1_admin with recreate_test_users.py and deleted them afterwards with iter15_cleanup.py. Nothing else created. No PitchAPI, ingest or engine jobs were run.
